heroSection.heroTitle: Architecting the Future of Frontier Intelligence.
heroSection.heroSubtitle: Data Science Society unites elite researchers, algorithmic engineers, and domain specialists to construct verifiable, decentralized artificial intelligence ecosystems.

pillars.pillar1Desc: Collaborative research cohorts bridging theoretical machine learning and scalable real-world implementations.
pillars.pillar2Desc: Pioneering distributed neural architectures, verifiable compute paradigms, and federated learning protocols.
pillars.pillar3Desc: Commitment to 100% open-source datasets, preprints, algorithmic frameworks, and reproducibility standards.

about.title: Pioneering the Frontiers of Data & Artificial Intelligence
about.desc: The Data Science Society is an elite academic and engineering collective dedicated to advancing theoretical breakthroughs, decentralized architectures, and sovereign AI.

heroSection.heroSubtitle: Learn data science. Build things that matter. Find your people. We bring students, researchers, and builders together to explore what comes next.

pillars.pillar1Desc: Build confidence through practical workshops, study groups, and knowledge shared by your peers.
pillars.pillar2Desc: Turn ideas into projects. Explore research, experiment with real problems, and share the work behind your results.
pillars.pillar3Desc: Find collaborators, meet mentors, and contribute to a community where different perspectives belong.

about.title: Great ideas start with people.
about.desc: We are a community of students, researchers, and builders connected by a simple belief: we learn more, and go further, together.
